The complex ion $\text{[Au(CN)}_2\text{Br}_2\text{]}^{-}$ displays geometrical (cis/trans) isomerism.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.stem:
An impure sample of a vanadium(V) compound of mass $0.250\text{ g}$ is dissolved in aqueous acid. This solution contains $\text{VO}_3^{-}$ ions.

An excess of zinc is added to this solution. All the $\text{VO}_3^{-}$ ions are reduced to $\text{V}^{2+}$ ions and $\text{Zn}$ atoms are oxidised to $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ ions.

The unreacted zinc is removed and the resulting solution is titrated with acidified $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$.

The end-point is reached when $22.5\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.0750\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$ is added.

A redox reaction takes place and all the $\text{V}^{2+}$ reacts forming $\text{VO}_3^{-}$.

$$3\text{MnO}_4^{-} + 5\text{V}^{2+} + 3\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow 3\text{Mn}^{2+} + 5\text{VO}_3^{-} + 6\text{H}^{+}$$
parts.text:
Calculate the percentage by mass of vanadium in the $0.250\text{ g}$ of impure sample.

Assume the impurities do not contain any vanadium ions.

Show your working.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
Complete the equation for the reaction between acidified $\text{VO}_3^{-}$ ions and $\text{Zn}$ metal.

$$\ldots\ldots\text{VO}_3^{-} + \ldots\ldots\text{Zn} + \ldots\ldots \rightarrow \ldots\ldots\text{V}^{2+} + \ldots\ldots\text{Zn}^{2+} + \ldots\ldots$$
